race.name: Frostmanes
race.physicalDescription: Fur-covered northern clans whose songs encode maps across shifting ice.

traits: Protective of underdogs, openly rude to authority, and unable to resist proving a bully wrong.
Always assumes the best of monsters and the worst of institutions.

rules.name: Weight RULE
rules.description: Make one visible object somewhat heavier or lighter; cannot reduce weight to zero and requires concentration.

rules.name: Cold RULE
rules.description: Draw heat from a small nearby area; the displaced heat warms the user's body and can become dangerous.

rules.name: Magnetism RULE
rules.description: Pull or push small ferrous objects; precision and force decrease with range.

rules.name: Reflection RULE
rules.description: Look through a nearby reflection or distort what it shows; cannot pass matter through it.

talents:
Field Medic — +1 when stabilizing injuries or using mundane medical supplies.
Cold Immunity — The character cannot be frozen by ordinary cold.
Danger Sense — +1 to Reflexes when reacting to an unseen or unexpected threat.
equipment: Legendary light armor — A unique second skin offering exceptional protection without restricting movement.
Flail — A chained striking head capable of reaching around simple defenses.
inventory: Lantern and oil — A hooded lantern with enough oil for several hours.
Bedroll — A weather-resistant blanket and sleeping roll.
Small mirror — A polished hand mirror useful for signals and checking corners.
